note: MAME 2009's MVS BIOS lists COIN1, COIN2, ... under SETTING UP THE CABINET, so the script's cabinet change set COIN2 to 2 COINS = 2 CREDITS rather than CONTINUE; K.O.F.'98's own soft DIPs (PLAY TIME LITTLE FAST, CONTINUE OFF) are as intended and read back after the reset.

built_from.build: git show HEAD:Makefile > libretro-Makefile.mk (the repo holds both Makefile and makefile, which collide on a case-insensitive disk; the libretro build file is Makefile); make -f libretro-Makefile.mk platform=osx PTR64=1 FORCE_DRC_C_BACKEND=1 ARM_ENABLED=1 ARFLAGS=-crs AR=<sh wrapper that writes an empty archive when given no members, as GNU ar does> CC="cc -DSDLMAME_NO64BITIO -Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration -Wno-error=int-conversion -Wno-error=incompatible-function-pointer-types -Wno-error=incompatible-pointer-types" NATIVECC=cc -j14. No source edits; the osx section of the Makefile (CC = c++ for C sources, x64 DRC, no ARFLAGS) cannot build on arm64 with current clang, so these variables are overridden on the command line.
